en: A macho enemy and a thrilling brawl!{PAGE}It was a rather sweaty―excuse me―heated{SAUT}screening, and it left me very satisfied.
Glad to hear it.{OPTION}It was tough.
Yes, the surprising battle near the climax...{SAUT}My eyes were glued to the screen until the{SAUT}very end.{PAGE}And it looks like a new bond was formed{SAUT}between the two "men."
...And that's when we beat the{SAUT}ever-lovin' crap outta the Shadow!{PAGE}Whaddya think? It's a special attack I{SAUT}just thought up!
Yeeeah! That's perfect! Friggin' AMAZING!{PAGE}So, first I'll go, "Raaah," and then...?
Here, I wrote it down. We can practice it{SAUT}later!
Why don't we give it a name? Something{SAUT}super "manly"!
Good thinkin'! What about...
Looks like you two are getting along just{SAUT}fine now.
Wh-Why're you so quiet all of a sudden?
You've been staring at Morgana a lot{SAUT}lately.{PAGE}I thought it was 'cause you were tryna{SAUT}pick a fight.
Uh―No, it's not 'cause I don't like him...
I mean, yeah, a talkin' cat's pretty weird.{SAUT}But this one... He ain't that bad.
Stop calling me a cat!
Well, yeah I was looking at him, but it's{SAUT}just 'cause...
Because what...?
What!? Just say it!

Aarrgh! Just look how cute he is!{PAGE}How can I not be interested in somethin'{SAUT}that adorable!?{PAGE}I wanna see how fluffy he is... How his{SAUT}paws feel...{PAGE}I'm all about that shit, damn it!{PAGE}*gasp*
Ohh... So that's what it was.{PAGE}Why didn't you just say so? Have at him.
Seriously?
Wha―? Ryuji! You can't just―
Go ahead.{OPTION}Be gentle.{OPTION}I recommend his paws.
You too!?
O-Okay, here I go...{PAGE}H-Hold still, Mona... I'll be nice...
Eeeeek!
Get back here, Mona! Lemme feel how{SAUT}fluffy your chin is!
What kind of thief stops when someone{SAUT}tells them to!?{PAGE}Aaaahhh...!
